name: Ero Imo Hurricane! ~Idol no Imouto ga Erokute Erokute Ore no Risei ni Arashi no Yokan!?~
original_name: エロいもハリケーン！　～アイドルの妹がエロくてエロくてオレの理性に嵐の予感！？～
source:
"That's right! Can I come over to your place next time, big brother?"

The protagonist has been accepted into a university in the city and has decided to move closer to the university.

He is excited to get a girlfriend and live a life of luxury, but then his younger sister, an idol, moves in with him.

The protagonist ends up living with his younger sister, who has an abnormal interest in sex.

This is a slapstick, erotic comedy that involves his younger sister, who likes to try new things whenever she gets the chance, and her friends.
translation:
“没错！下次我可以去你家吗，哥哥？”

主人公考上了城里的大学，决定搬到离学校近一些的地方。

他期待着交到女朋友、过上奢侈生活，却没想到身为偶像的妹妹搬来和他一起住。

主人公最终和对性爱有着异常兴趣的妹妹开始了同居生活。

这是一部闹剧式情色喜剧，讲述喜欢一有机会就尝试新事物的妹妹，以及她的朋友们的故事。
